title: Inner-fibration lifting for exponential corner maps
statement:
Use simplicial sets, inner horns, internal functor simplicial sets and degreewise pullbacks of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $i:A\to B$ and $p:E\to F$ be maps of small simplicial sets. Assume that $i$ is injective in every simplicial degree and that $p$ is an inner fibration, meaning that it has the right lifting property against every $\Lambda_k^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ with $0<k<n$. Then the canonical map
$$\rho:\operatorname{Fun}(B,E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(A,E)\times_{\operatorname{Fun}(A,F)}\operatorname{Fun}(B,F),\qquad h\longmapsto(h\circ i,p\circ h),$$
is an inner fibration. No quasicategory hypothesis on $E$ or $F$ is required.
